name: ges-live-system-preview
description: Source lives in src/ (data.js, canvas.js, app.js). Run `npm run build` to compile them into the single app.js at the repo root - that compiled file is what gets uploaded to WordPress alongside index.html and styles.css. Never hand-edit the root app.js directly; edit src/ and rebuild.

scripts.build: esbuild src/app.js --bundle --outfile=app.js --loader:.js=jsx --jsx-factory=React.createElement --jsx-fragment=React.Fragment --banner:js="// Built from src/ via npm run build - do not edit this file directly."
